ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.

----
